item.title: 18×9″ Auto Strada Genova Magnesium Wheels for Nissan Skyline at No Reserve
item.description: These Auto Strada Genova wheels are constructed of forged magnesium and measure 18″ in diameter by 9″ wide. The five-spoke design was refinished under current ownership in silver with black script details. The seller reports they suit R32 and R33-generation Nissan Skyline GTR models. They are now offered at no reserve in Joetsu, Japan, with four center caps and valve stems.

item.title: 2001 Dodge Ram 2500HD SLT Quad Cab V10 4×4 at No Reserve
item.description: This 2001 Dodge Ram 2500HD SLT 4×4 is a ¾-ton Quad Cab pickup that remained registered to the original owner in Montana through the selling dealer's 2026 acquisition and now has 90k miles. Powered by an 8.0-liter Magnum V10 linked with a four-speed automatic transmission, a dual-range transfer case, and a limited-slip rear differential, the truck is finished in Dark Garnet Red over Agate cloth. item.title: Euro 1983 Lamborghini Countach LP5000 S
item.description: This 1983 Lamborghini Countach is one of approximately 321 examples of the LP5000 S built over a three-year production run. Chassis DLA12610 left the factory in July 1983 and was delivered new to Emilian Auto of Bologna, Italy, prior to being imported and federalized by Exotic Leasing of St. Paul, Minnesota, later that year.
